buildScript: vite build && vite build -c vite.reference.config.js && vite build -c vite.settings.config.js

lines: npm ci and npm run build succeed on the tracked files alone, in 55 s, and wrote what make build had just written into the checkout (--fresh), so a second build would only have repeated that comparison.
Nothing else was in the tree, which is the state a fresh clone and CI build in, so a build that needs a leftover from an earlier one would have failed here.
Every file in js/ and css/ is what this source builds.
js/: 453 files, in .gitignore; css/: 3 files, in .gitignore.
